game.name: RG808
game.desc: A Roland TR-808 style drum machine for your handheld: 1-16-step sequencer with 11 classic voices, per-step accents, sample-accurate timing, swing/ratchets, a 200-slot pattern library, 512-bar song chains with WAV export, and per-pattern master effects (bitcrusher/overdrive/compression, flanger/phaser, tempo-synced delay, reverb).
